title: Scene method-side block filter reads hosting account
description: Found while implementing JMAP-0x0q.57. draft-atwood-jmap-scene-00.md at jmap-chat-spec 33702a5 L2676: SceneAvatar records are removed when their userId 'corresponds to a ChatContact with blocked: true on the requesting user's contact list'. Code: crate-jmap-scene-server/src/helpers.rs (SceneAvatar Visible::visible) calls SceneBackend::is_user_blocked with the request's accountId, which for a shared region is the hosting account, not the requester's. Handlers do not know the requester's personal account. Options: (a) document that is_user_blocked must resolve the caller's own contact list from caller, ignoring account_id, for method-side calls; (b) add a backend hook returning the caller's personal account. Needs a decision.
notes: Mark 2026-10-21: option (a'). Drop account_id from SceneBackend::is_user_blocked; contract = 'is user_id blocked on the caller's own contact list'; delivery path builds the recipient's caller context. BREAKING, CHANGELOG. If the delivery path cannot build the recipient caller context, fall back to (a) with an honest parameter rename. Test: shared region hosted by A, requester B blocks avatar user -> notFound (scene-00 L2676 at 33702a5).
close_reason: Batch 10: committed and adversarially verified; CI green at d9d4d6af
